detail.longDescription: Omni is the AI engineer that takes your agents from a laptop to the cloud. Today, your best AI workflows still live in Claude on your machine - stopping when the lid closes, running for no one but you. Describe what you want, or bring what you've built, and Omni wires the tools and skills, tests on mock data, and hands you a running cloud agent: scheduled, long-running, shareable with your team. It keeps agents healthy too - improves system prompts, compares models, debugs and fixes failed runs.
